issues.description: Numeric threshold mismatch for the WHERE condition on the Gemeinde.einwohner_w attribute: the problem statement (problem_statement.md) specifies "mehr als 1000 weiblichen Einwohnerinnen" (i.e. WHERE ... einwohner_w > 1000) but the solution SQL (solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql) uses einwohner_w > 2000 in the WHERE clause. This inconsistency will confuse students about the correct filtering condition and can cause tests or grading to mark a correct student query (using >1000) as incorrect.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the numeric threshold consistent between problem statement and solution/tests. Recommended: update solution_repository/aufgabe04.sql line with the WHERE condition to use AND Gemeinde.einwohner_w > 1000 so it matches the problem statement. Alternatively, if the intended threshold is 2000, change problem_statement.md to state "mehr als 2000 weiblichen Einwohnerinnen" and update any tests/documentation accordingly. Ensure any automated tests that check the expected result use the same threshold.
